records.content: public Interval(final int start, final int end)

test_structure.details: Use analyze for checks/guards and references for helper targets; shared records remain in shared_ref.

limitations: static declared targets, not runtime dispatch
JUnit roles supported by source imports, not runtime discovery
data providers and extensions require explicit review
Initialization is source order evidence, not a runtime execution trace.
Lifecycle ordering assumes ordinary JUnit inheritance; extensions, nested/enclosing instances and providers need review.
Only resolved call/field edges are expanded; type-use and reflection dependencies may require queries.
next_actions: read: omitted or business bodies by id
references/resolve: inspect unresolved references and candidates
file: inspect annotations, imports or resource/config files
lookup: inspect supplied artifact items and their statuses
analyze: inspect source steps/checks/control contexts; features: inspect compatibility review items
